title: Auth service pods CrashLoopBackOff after config deploy
description: auth-service pods are repeatedly restarting and cycling into CrashLoopBackOff shortly after startup. Login and token-refresh requests are failing cluster-wide because there are no healthy pods left to serve traffic.
raw_logs: 2026-08-24T06:28:20.000Z INFO  [deploy-controller] rollout auth-service v5.2.0 started (ConfigMap with renamed secret volume mount)
2026-08-24T06:29:02.400Z ERROR [auth-service] FileNotFoundException: /etc/auth/keys/keycloak.pem (No such file or directory) — startup aborted
2026-08-24T06:29:15.100Z WARN  [kubelet] Pod auth-service-6f8b4-3 container auth: restarting, exitCode=1, reason=Error
2026-08-24T06:29:58.700Z ERROR [kubelet] Back-off restarting failed container auth in pod auth-service-6f8b4-3 (crash count 9, back-off 5m0s)
2026-08-24T06:30:41.300Z ERROR [auth-service] Spring Boot startup failed: required secret volume mount path /etc/auth/keys is missing (expected /etc/auth/secrets)
2026-08-24T06:31:12.900Z ERROR [lb-auth] zero healthy endpoints for service auth-service: login/token-refresh requests failing 100%

raw_events.description: Deployed auth-service v5.2.0 with updated ConfigMap referencing a renamed secret volume mount
Secret volume mount path changed from /etc/auth/secrets to /etc/auth/keys in the new Helm values
